subject: Reuse `obey_client` variable in `processCommand()` function (#1101)
reason: The change only caches the result of mustObeyClient(c) in a const local and reuses it at the two later call sites in processCommand(). mustObeyClient() depends only on c->id and c->flag.primary, and nothing between the computation and the former call sites (auth check, CMD_NO_MULTI check, ACL check — all of which only reject and return) can mutate those fields, so the cached value is always identical to a fresh call. This is a pure refactor with no behaviour change, so no scenario is needed.
